title: 61 ## NATURE OF PROPERTY STOLEN AND RECOVERED Table XXII presents the nature of property stolen and recovered during 1970, while the detailed statistics for the States, Union Territories and Cities are furnished in Appendices XXXI to XXXVI. The highest amount of Rs. 437.2 lakhs of property stolen was in respect of Thefts of motor vehicles and accessories and this very head indicated the highest percentage of recovery viz. 60.6%. The percentage recovery in respect of Copper wire was the lowest i.e. 11.5%.
